_comment: CRM sales-traceability configuration for the whistlebird_test tenant, replayed through the real API by scripts/whistlebird_crm.py after the Core history (see docs/whistlebird-replay-plan.md). The scoped reset deletes product_mappings and crm_sales_traceability_config, and neither is recoverable from the legacy database, so they live here. The Xero OAuth connection cannot be replayed: reconnect it in the app after a rebuild, then sync. Mappings are name-only (no biz_e_source_output_id), exactly as created in the CRM UI, because output UUIDs change on every rebuild.

product_mappings.notes: Founder reviewed INV-0247 and INV-0248 (2026-09-19): the generic 'Whistlebird Gin - Bin stock' lines, item code WBRS01-4625, are Rosella.
